up: Return the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613996. Include the standard relation, standard value, and standard units for the activity.
sql: SELECT activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM activities JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613996'
